text: {"name":"hal_signal_eligible_slots","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Under an IRQ-preserving critical section, scans five slots and sets the hardware bit for each eligible slot, then marks a shared state byte.","subsystem":"hal","var_renames":{"i":"slot_index","v0":"critical_section_depth","v1":"slot_state_base","v2":"shared_state_base","v3":"slot_state_cursor","v4":"slot_status_cursor","v6":"depth_before_unlock","v7":"depth_after_unlock","v8":"irq_restore_pending"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":158,"meaning":"Per-slot byte that must be zero for the slot's hardware bit to be set; slots are traversed at 28-byte spacing."},{"offset":190,"meaning":"Selected slot identifier excluded when the mode bit is set."},{"offset":208,"meaning":"Mode flags; bit 0 enables the selected-slot exclusion."},{"offset":336,"meaning":"Per-slot status word that must be nonzero before signaling."},{"offset":511,"meaning":"Shared state byte set to 1 after the slot scan."}]}
